title: Tall, spiral shaped department store
content: Had anyone encountered a department store that is laid out across numerous levels and is shaped in a spiral? For lack of a better word to describe it. The levels are very small/compact/narrow as are the different sections of the store, making it difficult to navigate. There are are either stairs or escalators in the middle of the store that allow you to go between the different floors/levels but it's hard to tell where one level starts and the next begins due to the spiral shape.
